summary: Found the authors' own repo MasLiang/AutoClock directly linked in the paper on page 2 ("The open-source repository is available at: https://github.com/MasLiang/AutoClock"). The repo contains Vitis HLS designs (58 HLS files detected by hls_scan.py), matching the paper's focus on automated clock management for HLS on FPGAs. The first author (Jiawei Liang, GitHub user MasLiang) is verified via git log. No other third-party repos need reporting (PyHDI/Pyverilog is only a cited reference tool, not a repo the paper builds on as its subject).
